{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few values of the 'revenue' column to see if they are strings like '0.00'
revenue_sample = df['revenue'].head(10)

# Check for non-numeric strings (e.g., 'nan', '0.00', etc.)
# Convert to string and check for non-float patterns
non_numeric = df['revenue'].astype(str).str.contains(r'^[0-9]*\.[0-9]*$')

# Count how many are non-numeric
non_numeric_count = (~non_numeric).sum()

revenue_sample, non_numeric_count"}
